steps: Log in to SNU eTL, open the course list, and enroll in the [공과대학] 생명존중(자살예방)교육 course.
Watch at least 80% of the video lectures, then take the quiz.
Go to eTL → My Menu (your name) → 비정규 강좌 수강 → 진행중/종료 to issue your certificate.
